areas.notes: AB curation 2026-11-02. Whole park. Compared with the Parks Canada Banff hiking page (https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/randonnee-hiking): day hikes present (Johnston Canyon, Lake Agnes, Plain of Six Glaciers, Larch Valley, Sentinel Pass, Eiffel Lake, Paradise Valley, Taylor Lake, Helen Lake, Bow Glacier Falls, Chephren Lake, Parker Ridge, Nigel Pass, Cirque Lake, Deception Pass, Wenkchemna Pass, Sunset Lookout, Boom Lake, Mystic Lake, Sundance Canyon, Cascade Amphitheatre, Mount Rundle/Cascade/Temple scrambles, backcountry passes). Unmapped or unnamed in OSM (known omissions): Lake Louise Lakeshore, Rockpile Loop, Consolation Lakes, Lake Annette, Hidden Lake, Mistaya Canyon, Peyto/Bow Summit viewpoints, Dolomite Pass, Sarbach Lookout. Excluded: boundary-clipped stubs (<85% of the route inside the polygon), Trans Canada Trail legs, horse trails, approach/descent/alt variants, abbreviated or numeric duplicate stitches, informal Nordic/MTB network names. Great Divide Trail excluded as long-distance. live-fix1 2026-11-02: pin moved from [51.494, -116.155] (2.24 mi from the nearest trail) to a trail point next to the trail-extent midpoint. live-fix1 remediation (review #717): restored Fairview Mountain Trail, Simpson Pass Healy Pass Trail (agency-listed or only link to a listed trail). areas.name: Jasper National Park
areas.notes: AB curation 2026-11-02. Whole park. Compared with the Parks Canada Jasper day-hike pages (https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/experience/sentiers-trails). Kept: backcountry trails (Skyline, Tonquin Valley, Fryatt, Brazeau, Maligne Pass, Jonas Pass, Poboktan, Snake Indian Falls, Overlander), day hikes (Cavell Meadows, Edith Cavell Pond, Opal Hills, Maligne Canyon, Sulphur Skyline, Pyramid, Whistlers, Wilcox Pass, Mary Schaeffer Loop, Valley of the Five Lakes) and named scrambles. Excluded: the numbered Jasper town MTB/fitness trail network (Trail N, Sidewinder, Swamp Rider...), informal climbing paths, boundary-clipped stubs, alt/duplicate pieces; Great Divide Trail dropped by the Canada filter as long-distance. Remediation (review #704): hiking trails Wabasso, Mina, Curator, Saturday Night, High Lakes, Minnow, Stutfield Ice Cave, Cinquifoil, Morrow reinstated and renamed; Edith Cavell Pond Trail composite excluded. live-fix1 2026-11-02: pin moved from [52.804, -117.634] (3.37 mi from the nearest trail) to a trail point next to the trail-extent midpoint. live-fix1 remediation (review #717): restored The Whistlers Summit Trail, Pyramid Mountain Trail (agency-listed or only link to a listed trail).

areas.name: Waterton Lakes National Park
areas.notes: AB curation 2026-11-02. Whole park. Compared with the Parks Canada Waterton trail table (https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/waterton/activ/experiences/randonee-hiking): Bear's Hump, Bertha Lake, Crypt Lake, Crandell Lake, Blakiston Falls, Carthew/Alderson legs, Lineham Creek, Rowe Lakes, Twin Lakes, Wishbone, Tamarack, Vimy Peak, Avion Ridge, Linnet Lake and Townsite Loop are present. Red Rock Canyon (0.7 km loop) kept by waiver. Snowshoe (winter only), horse bypasses and clipped stubs excluded. Akamina Lake, Lower Rowe Lake and Cameron Lakeshore not shipped (stub/unmapped). Crypt Lake Trail is left to the live US Waterton areas (duplicate gate); known omission here. live-fix1 2026-11-02: added Crypt Lake (whole 6.2 mi in Waterton; its 0.33 mi clipped stub in the US area waterton-lakes-national-park-mt is not touched and should be retired by the US owner) and Snowshoe; Carthew-Alderson, Lakeshore, Blakiston Valley and Boundary Creek have no named way in OSM; Akamina Pass is boundary-clipped (0.9 of 1.6 mi inside). Peak and route items dropped.

Kept 9 hiking trails: Beaver Creek, Beaver Creek Loop, Mitchell Creek, Rangers, Lakeside, Cougar Ridge, Tower, Old Baldy, Spruce Coulee (above the 2-trail floor).

The earlier hold said the three names had no official source; they do: the Alberta Parks Cold Lake park map (https://www.albertaparks.ca/media/wc2ldl0x/cold-lake-tear-sheet.pdf, linked from https://www.albertaparks.ca/parks/north/cold-lake-pp/) labels Lakeshore Trail, Campground Trail and Main Road Trail, and the park page gives 9 km of formal hiking/biking trails. OSM: Lakeshore Trail 2.09 mi, Campground Trail 2.01 mi, Main Road Trail 1.57 mi (98-99% inside) = 5.67 mi = 9.1 km, the whole formal network. Informal trails in the north of the park are unmaintained and not mapped by name. Pin moved from 54.6,-110.1 to the kept-trail vertex nearest the curated trail-extent midpoint (54.469,-110.124).

Ball Pass, Simpson River, Boom Mountain and Monarch trails cross into Banff / Mount Assiniboine and are excluded as boundary-clipped (they belong to those areas). live-fix1 2026-11-02: pin moved from [50.942, -116.093] (7.76 mi from the nearest trail) to a trail point next to the trail-extent midpoint. Gate box is the north-band bbox midpoint 51.1401,-116.1745 +/- 0.1 deg. Registry-only; 18 trails/80.1 mi unchanged.

areas.name: Garibaldi Provincial Park
areas.notes: BC curation 2026-11-02. Whole park. BC Parks lists Diamond Head (Elfin Lakes), Black Tusk / Garibaldi Lake (Rubble Creek, Taylor Meadows), Cheakamus Lake, Singing Pass, Russet Lake and Wedgemount Lake (https://bcparks.ca/garibaldi-park/). Present: Black Tusk, Panorama Ridge, Garibaldi Lake, Elfin Lakes, Cheakamus Lake, Helm Creek, Mamquam Lake and named scrambles. Wedgemount Lake, High Note and Overlord are boundary-clipped and excluded. Whistler-side mountain-bike names are all sub-0.6 mi stubs and dropped. OSM splits the main trails into partly unnamed ways, so several distances are shorter than the official ones. HELD 2026-11-02 (review #707): Garibaldi Lake 1.31 mi, Elfin Lakes 2.21, Black Tusk 1.49 and Panorama Ridge 1.68 are disjoint OSM stubs of 5.6-9 mi routes and Wedgemount is clipped; same defect as Joffre. Needs OSM completion before shipping. Known omission (review #707): Wedgemount Lake. Retry 2026-11-02 (ca-missing): replay unchanged, 19 trails / 45.5 mi. No registry-only route: OSM has no hiking relation for the named trails, only name-stitched ways (Garibaldi Lake Trail 13 ways / 5.8 mi but 1.3 mi assembles, Singing Pass Trail 7.3 mi and Taylor Meadows 2.0 mi are absent from the replay), so Black Tusk, Garibaldi Lake, Panorama Ridge and Elfin Lakes stay stubs. Still HOLD; needs OSM relations or an engine stitch rule. Re-check 2026-11-10 (BC-1): replay unchanged, 19 trails / 45.5 mi; Garibaldi Lake 1.31 mi (23% of its 5.76 mi of named ways), Elfin Lakes 2.21 (31%), Black Tusk 1.49 and Panorama Ridge 1.68 are still disjoint stubs. Stays held (needs OSM completion).

Whiteshell River Self-guiding Trail not mapped by name. Hunt Lake Trail excluded as an OSM stub (3.97 of about 10 mi). North and South Whiteshell Trails (rwn multi-use regional networks, 47.4 and 16.9 mi) are long-distance legs and stay out. Several OSM trails (Centennial, Cabin Lake, Lost Lake, Jessica Lake, White Pine, High Lake, Top of the World, Bear Lake, Sturgeon Falls) are mapped hiking routes not on the pages read; kept as OSM-named hiking routes, unverified against Manitoba Parks. Known omissions: Hunt Lake Trail (3.97 of about 10 mi in OSM, excluded as a stub; no registry route) and Whiteshell River Self-guiding Trail (unmapped by name). Centennial Trail (26 mi, network tag lcn) is an OSM hiking relation kept as mapped, not verified against Manitoba Parks. areas.notes: ON A-rem curation 2026-11-12 (Phase A overflow, chat/ca-arem-on; T1 draft from scripts/ca_discover.py on main 8bd2611e5). HOLD. Ontario Parks activities page (https://www.ontarioparks.ca/park/driftwood/activities) lists the Oak Highland Trails (Riverview Loop 1 km, Beaver Pond Loop 2.5 km, to an Ottawa River lookout) and the Chevrier Creek Trails (4 loops, 1.3-3.7 km). OSM carries bare numbered names (Loop 1, Loop 2, Loop 4) for the Chevrier Creek loops and splits Oak Highland across three names (Oak Highland Trails: Beaver Pond 1.16 mi = 75% of the loop, Oak Highland Trail: Riverview 0.68 mi, Oak Highland Trails 0.63 mi). Numbered names are not signed trail names and the Beaver Pond loop is not whole under one name; needs a rescope (renames + merge) before it can ship.
